answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The zephyr of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the gale until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vine of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
